senses.gloss:
लोप m. (-पः)
 1. Rejection, cutting off in general, especially used as a
grammatical term for dropping letters, syllables, &c.
 2. Dis-
appearance, destruction.
 3. Erasure.
 4. Annulling, cancelling. E.
लुप् to cut, aff. घञ् ।

लोपा f. (-पा) The wife of the Muni AGASTYA.
 E. लुप् to disturb, affs.
अच् and टाप्ः see लोपामुद्रा ।

लोपाक m. (-कः) A jackal.
 E. लुप् to cut, आकन् aff.

लोपापक m. (-कः) A jackal.
 f. (-पिका) A fox.
 E. लोप rejection, (offal,)
आप् to take, aff. वुन् ।

लोपामुद्रा f. (-द्रा) The wife of the saint AGASTYA and daughter of the
king of Vidarbha. It was for her that the saint went out to
acquire riches and destroyed VĀTĀPI and ILVALA in the attempt.
E. लोप losing, (reputation,) अमुद्रा sad, not happy.

लोपामुद्रापति m. (-तिः) The Muni AGASTYA.
 E. लोपामुद्रा as above, पति husband.

लोपाशक m. (-कः) A jackal.
 f. (-शिका)
 1. A female jackal.
 2. A fox.
E. लोप rejection, अश् to eat, aff. ण्वुल् ।

लोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be rejected, erased, lost, &c.
 E. लुप् to cut off, ण्यत् aff.

लोप्त्र nf. (-प्त्रं-प्त्री) Plunder, booty.
 E. लुप् to cut off, ष्ट्रन् aff.
